Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misapplied logic by comparing the directors’ ages at their films’ release years (54 vs. 44) instead of directly comparing their birth years. Despite having the correct birth years—Fernando Di Leo (1932) and Don Hahn (1955)—the Planner concluded that Don Hahn was born earlier because he was older at the 2009 release of Waking Sleeping Beauty, which is incorrect. The correct comparison shows Mister Scarface’s director (Di Leo, 1932) was born earlier.
